items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: Rosh used to call him Nashwa.

ctx.x: Yeah. She wrote a letter to Ahmet Ertegun, I think trying to get him involved in the Robin Hood Foundation to donate pictures or something for auction by the Robin Hood Foundation and she mentioned, well my father recorded for Atlantic in 1958 with Les Jazz Modes and your late brother Nesuhi was the A&R man. Rosh used to call him Nashwa.
What were they like, as the three personalities? Did they mesh pretty well?
